chunk_text: You can access statistical data of 48+ European Union nations and other countries . Mirror Data Mirror Data contains data of those countries whose direct data is not available and re-structured on the basis of data of their partner countries. Our database covers 190+ countries mirror data that is better than no data. Bill of Lading Data Bill of Lading Data is based on shipping documents and contains companies’ shipment information but pricing details are not available. chunk_text: Import export data is a collection of stats based on details of shipments that pass through transport modes like sea, air, and road. The data contains Date, Importer Name, Exporter Name, HS Code, Product Description, Origin Country, Destination Country, Port, Value Quantity, Transport Mode, etc. Where can i find import export data online You can find import export data online at Export Genius, a leading provider of 190+ countries’ global trade data, including 62+ countries’ detailed customs data, and 33+ countries’ exclusive data. How do I find export import data? Yes, you can search Bangladesh export/import data by entering correct HS Code at Chapter, Heading or Sub-heading level and view number of shipment records. chunk_text: What type of data I can search here? You can search two types of data – Detailed Customs Data, and Statistical Data. However, in our Dashboard, we provide all types of data – Detailed Customs Data, Statistical Data, Weekly Detailed, Mirror Data, Bill of Lading Data, Cargo BL Data, Suez Canal Data, and Transit Data. Can I search data by Product only? Yes, you can search data by entering name of the product. Can I search data by HS code only? Yes, you can search data by entering HS Code. How many countries covered in your database? Our database covers 190+ countries’ global trade data, including 62+ countries’ detailed customs data, and 33+ countries’ exclusive data. Types of Data You Provide? We provide 7 types of import-export data – Detailed Data, Statistical Data, Transit Data, Bill of Lading Data, Cargo BL Data, Suez Canal BL Data, and Mirror Data. Detailed Data: Detailed Data covers 100% complete customs-based data with Importer and Exporter Details along with other shipment information.

Statistical Data: Statistical Data does not contain Companies’ Names but it has other useful information such as Quantity, Country, Price, etc. Transit Data: Transit Data covers the information of import-export shipments, which pass through different customs territories. Bill of Lading Data: This data is based on Bill of lading documents. It contains companies’ details but pricing information is not available. Cargo BL Data Cargo Data is a type of BL data, which is collected from various shipment companies. Suez Canal BL Data: Suez Canal Data contains bill of lading data of shipments, which move through Suez Canal. Mirror Data: Mirror Data contains information, which is reported by partner countries of countries that do not report their trade data. Do you Provide Contact Details?

Learn More Customs Data contains company names, besides other shipping details like HS Code, Product, Port, Origin/Destination Country and so on. Statistical Data covers Date, Quantity, Price, Quantity, Country, etc. to analyze market price of goods and other trade aspects. Mirror Data is a data of non-reporting countries and restructured from data reported by their partner countries. Bill of Lading Data is based on shipping documents and covers company details & other shipment information, but pricing is not covered.

Cargo BL Data Cargo Data is a type of BL data, which is collected from various shipment companies. Suez Canal Data contains bill of lading data of shipments, which move through Suez Canal.
